name: Snack Escort
description:
About This Game

Who would’ve thought that a roguelike, card game, and tower defence could unite over a basket of food?
In Snack Escort, you will traverse magical lands filled with hungry creatures eager to snatch your precious cargo. Each run brings new challenges and surprises.

Collect cards and artifacts that shape how you face your enemies. Build your own deck of heroes, traps, and special abilities to fend off waves of foes. Your choices determine the fate of your basket and your strategy.

              

              

Set up defences and plan your moves like in tower defence. Place units and traps in strategic locations to protect your food. Each battle map is unique and demands new tactics and adaptability — the enemies never rest, and the world won’t wait.

Every run is an adventure. Discover new card combinations, acquire powerful artefacts, and overcome increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Snack Escort is for those who love challenges, strategic decisions, and a touch of humour in a whimsical fantasy world.

Add Snack Escort to your wishlist and be the first to defend your precious basket when the journey begins.
